title: S4-LEARN-04 — A coach teaches one pose at a time.
goal: In a lesson, a partial tracing gives a score above zero and below Matched and offers What's missing?; using it does not change the tracing; Trace it for me matches only the current pose, and the next pose is still unfinished.

steps.why: The first pose is the one being traced.
One traced cell gives a partial score, well below a match.
A partial tracing offers the gap overlay.
Showing the gaps does not change the tracing.
The current pose is now matched.
The next pose was not completed for you.

cliOnly: learning gains are never claimed; Show me's ghost demonstration timing (tests/production/practiceIsolation.spec.ts)
